content:
What do you think is causing Deadlock to thrive while games like Highguard and concord fail almost instantly? What sets them apart?
You would think Deadlock would be at a disadvantage.

This game has -

Zero Advertising.

Is still invite only.

Its very unfinished.

Valve has barely even acknowledged its existence.

Yet it has very healthy numbers on steam, hovering at around 100k players over the last few weeks. So i am curious to know what people think about this games ability to outlive others.
